title: PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT — Collectible packaging for display and storage, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT — client objects and packaging conditions

## Set inventory

- Set name: PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT.
- Contents: F01 × 1 + A01 × 1 + A02 × 1 = three physical pieces.
- Range: one set, one SKU.
- F01 identity views: f01-front.png, f01-back.png and f01-right.png; three views of the same single figure.
- A01 identity view: a01-signal-paddle.png.
- A02 identity view: a02-sample-canister.png.
- Image provenance: original generated object references.
- Image information: fixed object identity and matte color/material appearance.
- Numeric dimension source: client dimension records.
- Packaging development: one coherent reusable structure; box size, opening method, insert layout, panel proportions, packaging colors and graphic language selected during design.

## Fixed object identities

| ID | Piece | Fixed appearance and construction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | Field Scout figure | Cream egg-shaped head/body; black horizontal capsule visor within a coral surround; two short attached cream arms; two broad cobalt feet; permanent pale-teal rear backpack; one fixed yellow-tipped mast on the character's right; matte resin-like appearance. All components remain attached in every state. Integral feet form the sole support plane. |
| A01 | Signal paddle | One orange open oval ring with a short solid handle; one complete decorative accessory. |
| A02 | Sample canister | One cobalt cylindrical decorative shape with a permanently closed shallow stepped top; one complete accessory. |

- F01 front-view orientation: character-right appears on image left.
- F01 rear-view information: backpack, attached arms, feet and mast root.
- F01 right-profile information: mast and backpack depth relationships.
- F01 complete assembly: head/body, visor, arms, feet, backpack and mast.
- F01 functions: decorative collectible.
- A01 and A02 functions: decorative accessories.
- Object colors and matte finish: as supplied in the five identity images, including illustrated depictions in packaging graphics.

## Object dimensions

All dimensions in mm.

| ID | Overall object envelope | Orientation and extent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | 76 W × 58 D × 112 H | Upright; total envelope includes mast and backpack. |
| A01 | 28 W × 50 H × 8 thickness | Flat storage; long and short plan axes may rotate with the layout. |
| A02 | 26 diameter × 32 H | Upright storage; stepped top included in the single object. |

## Package limits and clear accommodation

- Maximum closed external package envelope: 180 W × 160 H × 100 D mm.
- Actual closed dimensions: selected in the structure specification within the maximum envelope.
- Clear accommodation basis: usable space after walls, liners and closure parts, with local sole contact and retrieval allowances.
- Dimensional relationship: chosen wall and insert thicknesses accounted for between usable internal space and external dimensions.

| ID | Minimum usable accommodation | Allowance and access |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | 82 W × 64 D × 115 H mm | Width 76 + 3 + 3; depth 58 + 3 + 3; height 112 + 3 above the supporting soles. Highest mast tip receives 3 mm top clearance. Gentle location at robust feet/sole area. |
| A01 | 54 × 32 mm clear plan space × 10 mm clear depth | Separate identifiable recess; long and short axes may rotate; finger-access opening or equivalent retrieval feature. |
| A02 | 28 mm clear diameter × 34 mm clear height | Separate identifiable upright recess with a retrieval feature. |

- F01 handling support: robust body/feet area.
- F01 protected projecting and face features: mast, visor, arms and backpack.
- Insert spatial record: labeled plans and sections.

## Display, storage and repacking states

| State | Package and contents relationship |
| --- | --- |
| Closed storage | All three pieces retained in their assigned locations within the closed package. |
| Open display | F01 clearly visible; A01 and A02 separately stored and retrievable; all three pieces within the same package system. |
| Repacking | Same three pieces returned to the same locations in the open package before closure. |

- Display structure: same box and retained insert as closed storage.
- Optional integrated elements: drawer, folded support or retained cover, established in the initial structure specification and structure board.
- Closure: one repeatable opening and closing mechanism preserving the box and display/insert assembly.
- Collector operation: repeatable mechanical access and closure.

## Four-panel handling sequence

| Panel | Purpose | Contents relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Opening the closed package | Retained insert exposed. |
| 2 | Lifting F01 using its robust body/feet area | Mast, visor, arms and backpack remain clear of lifting contact; A01 and A02 remain in their recesses. |
| 3 | Returning the set | F01 upright; A01 and A02 in their own marked locations. |
| 4 | Closing the same package | All parts clear of the closure path. |

- packing-sequence composition: four panels within one board.
- repack composition: one clear open-before-close state with all three pieces returned.

## Required copy and surfaces

| Surface | Exact printed wording | Hierarchy or grouping |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Front | PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT | Dominant collection name. |
| Front | Collectible display set | Descriptor below the collection name in hierarchy. |
| Back | Set includes | Inventory heading. |
| Back | 1 × Field Scout figure (F01) | First contents entry. |
| Back | 1 × Signal paddle (A01) | Second contents entry. |
| Back | 1 × Sample canister (A02) | Third contents entry. |
| Back | Decorative collectible. No electronic functions. | Complete sentence pair. |
| Two sides collectively | PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT | Set identity. |
| Two sides collectively | F01, A01, A02 | Source IDs as inventory references. |

- Side instruction text: concise opening and repacking wording developed for the chosen structure and four-panel handling sequence.
- Side information distribution: set identity, source IDs and handling instructions shared across the two panels.
- Typographic identifier: designer-developed treatment of PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT.
- Print-artwork mapping: actual delivered front, back and two side graphics, plus necessary graphics on any additional visible faces.
- Mapping annotations: face names, orientation and fold/opening relationships.
- Face-size source: dimensioned structure board within the structure specification.

## Materials and joints

- External box material: selected in the structure specification.
- Insert material: selected in the structure specification.
- Nominal thicknesses: stated for the chosen box and insert materials.
- Closure/joint method: one repeatable system shared by all states.
- Section content: delivered box and insert, thickness allowances, joint construction and intact display/insert assembly during opening.
- Visible material relationships: edges, windows, folds and supports consistent with the selected materials and thicknesses.

## Application records

| Application | Quantity and setting | Package state and contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shelf | Exactly three copies of one SKU on a neutral retail shelf | Same closed package repeated; delivered proportions, front identity and visible side graphics. |
| Desk | Exactly one complete package on a plain collector's desk | Delivered open-display configuration; one F01 visible, A01 and A02 in their assigned storage locations within the same system. |

- Cross-view constants: toy identity, part count, relevant dimensions, exact surface copy, closure mechanism and panel relationships.
- Technical annotation scope: dimensions and labels relevant to each drawing's purpose.
- Technical label appearance: readable at the delivery catalog's assigned size.
- Video duration: 10 seconds.
- Presentation length: at least eight pages.

| 11 | shelf-application | Three-copy retail shelf application | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

| 13 | package-video | Opening, display and closing video | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | presentation | Packaging presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# PIP-01 Field Scout — client dimension record

- Dimension source: original client parameters.
- Unit: mm.
- ONE SET = F01 x 1 + A01 x 1 + A02 x 1 = THREE PHYSICAL PIECES

| ID | Piece | Dimensions (mm) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | Field Scout figure | 76 W x 58 D x 112 H | Upright overall envelope includes fixed mast and backpack. One complete attached figure with integral supporting feet. |
| A01 | Signal paddle | 28 W x 50 H x 8 thickness | Orange open oval ring with solid short handle. One accessory; flat orientation may rotate in the insert. |
| A02 | Sample canister | 26 diameter x 32 H | Cobalt cylinder with fixed shallow stepped top. One permanently closed decorative shape with an integral top. |

## Reference roles

- F01 identity: generated front, back and right images of one object.
- A01 and A02 identities: respective accessory images.
- Dimension and count authority: the records in this table.
- Packaging structure, insert layout and visual system: design selections.
- Required clear accommodation and maximum closed box envelope: 01-client-facts.en.md.

steps.userMessage:
PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT | Collectible packaging for display and storage

Our collectors keep the box. Develop one reusable package for PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT that becomes its display setting and gives each accessory a permanent storage position. One set contains three physical pieces: one F01 Field Scout figure, one A01 Signal paddle and one A02 Sample canister. The five identity images fix their forms and matte colors, including F01's attached mast and backpack. F01 measures 76 W × 58 D × 112 H mm overall; A01 measures 28 W × 50 H × 8 mm thick; A02 measures 26 mm in diameter × 32 H mm. The maximum closed external package is 180 W × 160 H × 100 D mm. Develop one structure through a specification first, then its applications.

F01 needs at least 82 W × 64 D × 115 H mm clear accommodation above its sole support plane. A01 needs a separate recess with 54 × 32 mm clear plan space and 10 mm clear depth; A02 needs a separate upright recess with 28 mm clear diameter and 34 mm clear height. Both accessories need retrieval access. Choose the materials, nominal thicknesses, actual box dimensions and repeatable closure. The same box and insert must support closed storage, open display with all three pieces within the package system, and repacking. Print "PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT" above "Collectible display set" in the front hierarchy. The back copy is "Set includes", followed by "1 × Field Scout figure (F01)", "1 × Signal paddle (A01)", "1 × Sample canister (A02)", and "Decorative collectible. No electronic functions." Across the two sides, print the set name, F01, A01 and A02, plus concise opening and repacking instructions.

Audience: collectors who retain packaging, and our product and packaging teams deciding how the set will be displayed, stored and prepared for sampling.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed objects, handling conditions, surface copy and application counts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. object-dimensions.en.md records the three pieces and their dimensions. object-accommodation.png is the constraint drawing for object envelopes, clear spaces and the closed-package limit. f01-front.png is the front identity reference for F01. f01-back.png is the rear identity reference for the same F01, including its backpack and mast root. f01-right.png is its right-profile identity reference. a01-signal-paddle.png is the identity reference for the orange paddle. a02-sample-canister.png is the identity reference for the cobalt canister. collector-shelf-context.png is an atmosphere reference for a collector's desk and shelving.

Deliverables:
1. One two-page structure specification, with a dimensioned structure board, actual external dimensions, face sizes, materials, nominal thicknesses and repeatable closure
2. One copy and surface schedule, with the front, back and two side texts and their locations
3. One insert layout board, with labeled plans and sections for F01, A01 and A02, usable clear dimensions, sole support and accessory retrieval features
4. One panel graphics board containing the front, back and two side designs
5. One flat print-artwork board mapping those four designs and any additional visible faces to the specified structure, with face names, orientation and fold/opening relationships
6. One materials-and-joints board, with a labeled section through the box and insert, thickness allowances and the closure in operation
7. One closed-storage package view containing the complete set
8. One open-display package view with F01 visible and both accessories stored within the same package system
9. One four-panel packing sequence: opening, lifting F01, returning the three pieces, and closing
10. One open-before-close repacking view with all three pieces returned to their assigned positions
11. One retail shelf application with exactly three copies of the same closed package
12. One collector's desk application with exactly one complete open package
13. One 10-second video showing the same package opening, displaying the set and closing
14. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the specifications, graphics, structure details, handling panels and application views

Acceptance:
- The structure specification establishes one package within 180 W × 160 H × 100 D mm. The flat print-artwork board repeats its face dimensions; the materials-and-joints board and presentation repeat its actual external dimensions, material names, nominal thicknesses and closure method.
- The insert layout board labels F01's 76 × 58 × 112 mm envelope within at least 82 × 64 × 115 mm clear space, A01's 50 × 28 × 8 mm envelope within at least 54 × 32 × 10 mm, and A02's 26 mm diameter × 32 mm height within at least 28 mm diameter × 34 mm height. Its plans and sections account for walls and liners, with F01 supported at its soles and both accessory retrieval features visible; the materials-and-joints board uses the same sections and thicknesses.
- The copy schedule, panel graphics and flat print-artwork carry the exact front and back wording stated above. The two side graphics together carry PIP-01 FIELD SCOUT, F01, A01, A02 and instructions matching the four-panel sequence. The presentation repeats the front name and descriptor alongside the delivered artwork.
- The closed-storage, open-display, repacking, desk and video deliverables retain one F01, one A01 and one A02 with the five identity references' forms and colors. The open-display and desk views expose F01 while both accessories remain separately stored and retrievable; all states use the specification's box, insert and closure.
- The packing sequence contains four panels in the stated order: opening exposes the retained insert; lifting supports F01 at its robust body/feet area while A01 and A02 remain stored; returning places all three pieces in their marked locations; closing leaves the closure path clear. The repacking view matches panel three, and the 10-second video follows the same opening and closing mechanism.
- The shelf application contains exactly three identical closed packages, and the desk application contains exactly one complete open package. The presentation has at least eight pages and reuses both scenes, the delivered panel artwork and the four handling panels.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
